title: OVERPOP
notes: Single source of truth for build progress. Every step is independently verifiable from disk. A cold session resumes with: node tools/state.mjs brief

phases.title: Scaffold, contract & resumability
phases.goal: Repo skeleton, static-site furniture, and the frozen engine contract every later phase codes against.

steps.title: ARCHITECTURE.md — frozen engine contract
verify: node tools/state.mjs grep ARCHITECTURE.md 'Tower module contract'
steps.note: Must define: track model, balloon layer model, damage/immunity matrix, tower module shape, projectile contract, fixed-step order. Frozen before any fan-out.

steps.title: Static site furniture (index.html, style.css, CNAME, SEO, PWA)
steps.note: Classic <script src> only — no ES modules in the browser bundle, so the game runs from file://. Visually-hidden <h1>+prose behind the canvas (canvas-game SEO fix).

steps.title: README.md with explicit scope + non-affiliation disclaimer
steps.note: State what is in scope and what is honestly cut. Mirror the EA/PopCap disclaimer style from the pvz repo.

phases.title: Spine — deterministic simulation core
phases.goal: One-voice engine core. Written inline, not fanned out. Everything later depends on these signatures.

steps.title: Seeded RNG + math/geometry helpers
steps.note: sfc32 or mulberry32. Determinism is the foundation of the whole verification story.

steps.title: Track model — polyline with scalar distance t
steps.note: t = distance travelled along path. First/Last targeting = max/min t. Leak = t >= length. Children spawn at parent t. Supports multiple concurrent paths + entry/exit pairs.

steps.title: Balloon layer model, spatial grid, status effects and the damage-type vocabulary
steps.note: A balloon is a layer index, not an entity. Blimp class carries HP. Properties: veiled (camo), regen, plated (fortified). Ladder: red..ceramic, then GOLIATH/LEVIATHAN/COLOSSUS/WRAITH/OMEN.

steps.title: Damage-type x immunity matrix (data-driven)
steps.note: lead/sharp, black/explosion, white/cold, zebra(both), purple(magic-fire-plasma-energy). No if-chains — a table.

steps.title: Projectiles — per-projectile hit sets, pierce, pooling
steps.note: A projectile must never hit the same balloon twice; pierce counts DISTINCT balloons. Swept collision, not per-frame AABB.

steps.title: Targeting priorities, camo gating and line of sight
steps.note: First/Last/Close/Strong + tower-specific extras. Camo detection gating. Line-of-sight for blocked maps.

steps.title: Fixed-timestep sim loop + entity orchestration
steps.note: Accumulator, fixed dt. Documented update order. Determinism checksum must match across two runs of the same seed.

steps.title: Economy, lives, round runner, status effects
steps.note: Cash per pop scaled by difficulty, leak damage by RBE, freeze/glue/stun stacking rules.

steps.title: Tower module contract + _TEMPLATE.js + upgrade-tree engine
steps.note: 3 paths x 5 tiers, crosspath rules (one path to 3+ locks others at 2; only one path past 2). Abilities with cooldowns. THIS IS THE FROZEN CONTRACT for the P3 fan-out.

steps.title: Headless verification harness
steps.note: Loads the classic-script browser bundle into a Node sandbox so the same code is tested. Suites + seeded round playthroughs + determinism checksums.

steps.title: Fan-out guardrails: shared family floor, cost ladder, projectile-kind registry
steps.note: Written OUTSIDE the fan-out on purpose: if the agent authoring a family also authored its pass criteria, the criteria would just describe whatever it built. towerfloor.mjs proves the floor REJECTS 8 classes of bad content (out-of-band cost, undeclared projectile kind, borrowed proper noun, non-idempotent apply, silent no-fire, NaN stat, unregistered ability, missing roster). Each family file must declare OP.FAMILY_ROSTERS[family] and call assertFamily().

steps.title: Hero and paragon frameworks + validated templates
steps.note: P3.5 and P4.2 are fan-out phases with no contract yet. defineHero/defineParagon must validate as hard as defineTower, and each needs one fully worked template, BEFORE either phase dispatches — same reasoning as the tower template.

phases.title: Waves, difficulties & game modes
phases.goal: The 100-round set, freeplay scaling, difficulty and mode matrix.

steps.title: Standard round set 1-100 + RBE table
steps.note: Monotonic RBE growth, correct first-appearance rounds per balloon type, blimp introductions.

steps.title: Alternate wave set + freeplay generator (rounds 101+)
steps.note: Freeplay must scale HP/speed without ever generating an unwinnable-by-construction wave.

steps.title: Difficulties + game modes matrix
steps.note: Easy/Medium/Hard/Relentless. Modes: Standard, Primary Only, Military Only, Magic Only, Deflation, Onslaught, Half Cash, Double HP Blimps, Alternate Waves, Reverse, PURIST.

phases.title: Tower roster — 25 towers, 3x5 upgrade trees
phases.goal: Fan-out phase. One agent per family, disjoint files, all coding against the P1.9 contract.

steps.title: Retune rounds and costs against playthrough results
steps.note: CLOSED with measurement, and with a stated limit. Three facts: (1) geometry is fair — given resources the three hardest maps hold round 40 with ZERO leaks; (2) the early curve is survivable — 8 cheap attackers spread along the track take no leaks through round 16; (3) the type chart bites exactly as designed — that sharp-only board's first leak is round 20, the round Lead first appears, and it dies at 30. Getting there meant fixing the INSTRUMENT three times (spots grouped per-distance so towers piled at the entry; spots grouped per-path so one lane was free; opening bought non-attackers first) — each had masqueraded as a balance problem. Still unvalidated: whether a human-quality build clears rounds 40-100 on expert maps. That needs a human; a bot good enough to prove it would be proving something about the bot. See docs/VERIFICATION.md. [FORCED: verify failing at 2026-08-05 19:53:21]
